items.title: Expert ranks top 5 U.S. tech companies to recruit from
items.summary: Investing.com -- Anthropic is the hardest U.S. technology company to recruit employees away from, according to AI recruitment specialist JC Christian, who shared his rankings during a Truist Securities investor call.

items.title: Truist, Fifth Third pause products tied to Mark Walter firm amid probe
items.summary: Investing.com -- Truist Financial (NYSE) and Fifth Third Bancorp (NASDAQ) have paused distribution of products tied to billionaire Mark Walter’s Delaware Life Insurance as a U.S. federal investigation puts growing pressure on his investment empire, Bloomberg reported Friday.

items.title: Truist Names Harold Ford Jr. as Adviser
items.summary: Truist Financial named a former U.S. congressman, Harold Ford Jr., as a vice chairman and strategic adviser.  Ford has worked in banking and finance since departing the House of Representatives in 2007, most recently at PNC Financial Services Group.

items.summary: CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) stock should have been under pressure following news that NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) is reportedly hiking prices for its GPUs by roughly 17%. items.title: NVDA Stock Posts Biggest Jump In 14 Months On $12 Trillion Valuation Call From Raymond James – ‘Supply Is The Primary Constraint’

items.title: CRM Stock Rips To 6-Month High In Biggest Single-Day Gain Since 2020: Analysts Call Salesforce Q2 ‘Narrative-Changing’
